# Skeleton

A loading state skeleton for your components.

Exports from `uiofcraft` and `uiofcraft/skeleton`: `Skeleton`.

## Usage

```tsx
import { Skeleton } from "uiofcraft"
```

```tsx
<Skeleton className="size-10 rounded-full" />
```

## API Reference

This is a custom component, not a Base UI wrapper.

### Skeleton

A simple div with animated pulse effect for loading states. Apply sizing and shape via className.
